name: One-Rep Max Calculator
description: Calculate your one-rep max (1RM) for bench press, squat, or deadlift using Brzycki, Epley, and Lander formulas, with a complete percentage breakdown table.
search_intent: Calculate one rep max (1RM) strength from weight lifted and reps.

inputs.label: Calculation formula
inputs.help: average, epley, brzycki, lander, or lombardi

calculation: If reps == 1, 1RM = weightLifted. Epley formula: w × (1 + r / 30). Brzycki formula: w × (36 / (37 − min(r, 36))). Lander formula: (100 × w) / (101.3 − (2.67123 × r)). Lombardi formula: w × r^0.10. Average 1RM combines Epley and Brzycki. Percentage training table calculates 95%, 90%, 85%, 80%, 75%, 70%, 65%, 60%, and 50% of the calculated 1RM. Input validation bounds reps to 1-30.
limitations: Formulas are most reliable between 1 and 10 repetitions; accuracy diminishes as reps exceed 10 due to muscular endurance factors.
Formulas assume full range of motion and standard technique.
Attempting true 1RM maximum lifts carries inherent musculoskeletal risk; always lift with trained spotters or safety pins.
